title: 3-Input Majority Gate
statement: Build a 3-input majority gate that outputs 1 when at least two of the three inputs are 1. The output must be low for one or zero asserted inputs. It is a basic voting circuit used in fault-tolerant systems and combinational logic designs.
module_signature: module majority_gate(input a, input b, input c, output y);
behavior: y is 1 when two or three inputs are 1.
y is 0 when zero or one inputs are 1.
The design must be pure combinational logic.
Purely combinational: outputs must settle after input changes.
Do not depend on initial register values, clocks, or delays.
All outputs must be driven to known 0/1 values for every input case.
hint: Compute the sum of the bits and compare to two.
